children.value: > Fact From Story: Losing the buy box is an “existential threat” to sellers’ businesses, the complaint alleges.

> > Fact From Story: The agency said Amazon punishes third-party sellers who offer cheaper products elsewhere by threatening to disqualify them from appearing in the buy box if it detects a lower price.
> > > Fact From Story: The end result of these tactics, the FTC argues, is elevated prices across the web.
> > > Commonsense Knowledge: Businesses try to avoid things that are an existential threat to them.
> > Commonsense Knowledge: A business will not do things that threaten its own existence.

> Fact From Story: The agency said Amazon punishes third-party sellers who offer cheaper products elsewhere by threatening to disqualify them from appearing in the buy box if it detects a lower price.
> > Fact From Story: Amazon’s software had detected that Ruckel’s popular cat toy, called the Ripple Rug, was being sold somewhere else for a cheaper price.
> > > Fact From Story: His product would no longer be shown in Amazon’s all-important buy box, an area of the listing where shoppers click “Add to Cart.”
> > > Commonsense Knowledge: Third party sellers want their products to be easily accessible on Amazon.
> > Commonsense Knowledge: Amazon wants to maximize its profits.
> Commonsense Knowledge: A business will not do things that threaten its own existence.
